text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek takes the Kikuka crown<n>and rushes
back to me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We bask in the glory of a victory<n>earned through
the power of our<n>bond.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Leaving behind the Classics that<n>taught us so
much, we set our sights<n>on the Nakayama
racecourse winter<n>race—the Arima Kinen!
